tvShows.name: Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment
tvShows.description: Triple the Laughter Tadka! Beloved celebrity couples gear up for a cooking face-off like no other—serving entertainment straight from the comedy kitchen. Watch Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment - Hindi Reality Comedy Food serial on JioHotstar now.

episodes.duration: Crispy jalebi with three rings is the challenge for celebrity couples. Who will win the golden star and claim the season's first victory?
Laddu showdown! Celebrity chefs battle it out under Chef Sokhi's watchful eye. Hilarious twists and intense competition‚Äîwho'll be crowned Laddu King?
episodes.episodeName: It's time to cook Shaadi Ke Laddu

episodes.duration: Desi delights take center stage as contestants cook up a storm. Sonam Bajwa and Ammy Virk judge the feast. Who will impress the stars and win?
A surprise birthday cake challenge throws contestants for a loop.  The chef simplifies it: decorate, but follow the rules! Who will bake the best?
Bharti Singh brings the laughs as contestants face a sweet challenge: making masala milk and ras malai. Can they handle the heat and complete the task?
Chocolate Balloon Bowls: a culinary challenge that tests nerves and skills.  Amidst the chaos, laughter fills the room. Who will emerge victorious?
Creativity, consistency, and taste - the judges demand it all in this culinary showdown. Shahi phal barfi, Shahi Korma, and Shahi Pulao: who will create the most delicious dishes?
Suniel Shetty joins the contestants as they whip up South Indian favorites like Sambaar and Medu Vada. Who will impress the action star?
With their family cheering and a family member on their team, the contestants are tasked to cook Chole Bhature. Who will leverage teamwork and family spirit to emerge victorious?
Get ready for a culinary showdown! Contestants must master Champakali Nimki, Tandoori Chai, and Pyaaz ka Achaar Parathas. Who will emerge as the winner?
Time to whip up some Pasta with Parma Rosa Sauce! Will the contestants conquer this exotic cuisine, or will it turn into a pasta party gone wrong? Watch the episode to find out!
Jannat Zubair Rahmani ties the knot in a hilarious stage play at Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment. Join the family fun!
Genies grant kitchen wishes, but will these chefs make the most of their magical help? 3 chefs per team, the drama heats up!
The contestants are tasked with making Zucchini Mushroom Brownies. With Orry Awatramani's presence on the show, you're in for twice the fun. Tune in for a laughter-filled episode!
The contestants from Khatron Ke Khiladi add an extra layer of excitement to the show as they join the chefs in preparing delectable Imarti. Tune in to the episode for more fun!
episodes.episodeName: Khiladis team up with the chefs

episodes.duration: As chefs cook Punjabi dishes, Dharmendra graces the show as a guest, bringing an element of fun. Catch the episode to discover if their efforts impress Dharmendra.
Vicky Jain's birthday brings laughter and fun to the set, but the real competition heats up with a "pav bhaji and gola" twist. Who will take home the win?
Our contestants are tasked with creating an exquisite platter for Naga Panchami. Who will rise as the ultimate culinary charmer in this showdown?
Fardeen Khan and Akshay Kumar bring the laughs with their kitchen shenanigans and witty banter. Don't miss this hilarious episode!
Bharti Singh and Kapil Sharma's team bring the laughs in a culinary comedy show. Watch as they cook up a storm and leave the audience in stitches.
Bharti Singh's Raksha Bandhan challenge: Contestants pay for Rakhis, then bake edible ones! Who makes the best?
Krishna Janmashtami feast! Contestants face a delicious challenge: Makhan Mishri, Kalakand, and Dhaniya Panjiri. Who will impress the judges and win the star?
Step back in time to the Golden Age of Hindi Cinema as chefs showcase their culinary artistry in iconic costumes.
Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment faces a grilling session. A team of journalists arrives, armed with questions. Can the contestants handle the pressure?
A culinary train journey! Laughter Chefs face off, creating Bharwa Karela & Methi Thepla. Who'll be the ultimate train snack master?
Kangana Ranaut joins the Ganesh Chaturthi festivities as chefs compete in a culinary showdown to impress her and win Bappa's blessings.
Jannat Rahmani judges as chefs face a Kashmiri culinary challenge. Partner exchange week puts their skills to the test. Will they impress?
Chef Harpal challenges his team to create a birthday feast for Nia Sharma, culminating in a stunning cake. Will they impress?
Ice cream challenge: chefs become quirky characters, infusing their creations with personality. Who will craft the most delicious and imaginative dessert?
Rahul Vaidya's birthday is a mix of joy and heartfelt blessings from transgender women. A Rajasthani cooking challenge adds a hilarious twist: chefs impersonate each other!
Soan Papdi meets cuteness! Chefs battle it out in a unique challenge, crafting Maharashtrian classics and adorable kitten desserts. Who will win?
Rebellious chefs, subdued by Bharti Singh, must now cook Khow Suey to earn their freedom. A culinary challenge tests their limits.
Navaratri's festive spirit meets stand-up comedy as Chef Harpal's Khandvi challenge tests culinary skills. Will laughter and dance lead to the perfect Khandvi?
Navaratri brings a fiery culinary showdown as chefs battle it out, creating delicious Mexican masterpieces. Who will be crowned the champion?

Chaos erupts as a new 'jail' rule imprisons contestants! Krushna's trapped, Abdu escapes, and mayhem ensues. Can they follow the rules? Watch now!
Rumali papad and jaljeera get a playful twist! Watch Laughter Chefs struggle, laugh, and learn in this culinary adventure. Will they conquer the challenge?

Valentine's Week has begun, and the laughter chefs are in for a sweet yet tricky challenge creating the perfect Dil-gulla! But Abhishek and Samarth are completely clueless about the recipe. Will they whip up a masterpiece, or will this sugary task take a spicy twist? Find out now!
1h 10m
1h 13m
Join Abhishek & Samarth for a hilarious candy floss attempt!  Their "unique technique" guarantees sticky stoves and lots of laughter. Watch the fun unfold!
Laughter Chefs prepare divine offerings for Shiv Ji, blending devotion with culinary creativity, promising a flavorful celebration.
Cricket fever takes over the Laughter Chefs' kitchen as Elvish and Abhishek lead teams to win both—the game of cricket and the game of culinary delights.
episodes.episodeName: Team Elvish vs Team Abhishek: Game on, Flame on!

episodes.duration: From silver screen to the kitchen, the jodi's embody Bollywood’s biggest icons while whipping up show-stopping dishes.
Laughter Chefs turns into a circus! Chef Harpal takes charge as the ringmaster, putting the jodis through fun-filled challenges to see who rules the ring.
In the International Women’s Day special, we celebrate the incredible women on Laughter Chefs with a feast of sweet treats & international cuisines!
The Laughter Chefs kitchen gets brighter as friends join the Holi fun! With colors flying and flavors mixing, it’s a splash of laughter, spice, and everything nice!
1h 17m
Abdu and Krushna drop beats, mixing rap with humor! Just as everyone grooves, swap is announced! Jaws drop, beats stop, and the real fun begins!
The beloved Gajar Kundra is back! Karan’s return leaves everyone teary-eyed, turning the kitchen into a heartwarming yet hilarious reunion.
episodes.episodeName: Bhola Is Back with a Bang!

episodes.duration: Laughter chefs turn into kids as Bharti unveils their hilarious report cards—bad grades, big laughs and food filled with childhood memories!
Laughter Chefs turn matchmakers! As they dive into fictional roles, the big question is — did they find the perfect groom for Mannara?
It’s a Bhauji Battle! Western Bhauji vs. Indian Bhauji—two teams, one kitchen, endless drama! The teams face royal food challenges blending with qawwali flavour.
Gossip turned grocery trip! The jodis hit the sabzi mandi, haggling and hustling with vendors in the funniest veggie shopping spree ever!
Laughter Chefs go divine! The jodis celebrate Ramnavami with festive flavors, whipping up dishes fit for the occasion with a dash of fun.
Plot twist alert! This time, it’s not the judge but the crew and audience who taste the dishes. Tables turn, taste buds talk, and surprises are served.
1h 8m
The kitchen gets a surprise tadka as three unexpected guests stir up nostalgia and non-stop masti! A 7th counter appears, and Sudesh Ji is definitely blushing... any guesses why?
episodes.episodeName: Surprise, Surprise: New Chaos in the Kitchen

episodes.duration: It is Chef Harpal’s birthday and the kitchen explodes with surprises—from his family, his team, and our jodis! Emotions run high and so does the masti!
Kitty Groups from across India crash the kitchen with gossip, glam, and loads of cheer for their favourite jodis! Will their tadka bring luck or total chaos?
Mango season is here, and the kitchen turns into a juicy celebration! From desi-style mango feasting to aam-tastic cooking challenges, it’s a messy, nostalgic, and deliciously fun ride.
Jodis went full Bollywood crazy as comic legends came alive! From goofy getups to epic giggles, this World Laughter Day was a comedy dhamaka you can’t miss!
Quirky merch, a glam fashion show, and bold food experiments take over the kitchen! One jodi struts away with the win—owning the ramp and the rasoi.
Summer camp vibes, kiddie chaos, and all jodis go all out to impress their cutest (and pickiest) critics yet!
This Mother’s Day, emotions run high as the jodis put their best dish forward to make their moms proud-because nothing beats maa ki tareef!
From milking buffaloes to cooking up desi delights, the jodis bring the flavor and fun straight from villages of india to the laughter chefs kitchen
Fasten your seatbelts! This kitchen's got a boarding call. From wacky announcements to global cuisine, the jodis fly high with flavours and fun.
Bharti storms in with her gang to set the kitchen straight! Munawar joins as the guest, and the chaos brews with fun, flavour, and full-on drama.
It’s headlines, hot takes, and hilarious bites as the kitchen turns into a newsroom! From juicy gossip to delicious drama.
Krushna came for cake, but got a shaadi! Watch this wild birthday bash where comedy meets commitment... again!
episodes.episodeName: From Happy Birthday to Happily Ever After!

episodes.duration: The people behind the magic are now in the spotlight! Celebrating 365 days of craziness with the crew who made it all possible!
Supersized dishes and supersized drama— serving everything in Double XL! Expect giant portions, bigger laughs, and chaos that’s off the charts as our chefs take on the ultimate jumbo challenge
1h 13m
Witty saas-bahu banter steals the spotlight with laughter at every turn. Lots of food & Quirky conversations reveal the charm of their timeless bond.
episodes.episodeName: India ki Saas Bahu in the house

episodes.duration: 1h 10m
World music day fever strikes and the kitchen hits a high note. Tuned or not, every performance brings the house down. A pitch-perfect mix of Music, Food  and Madness!
With every pose inspired and pinch of masala, the world Yoga Day kitchen cooked up calm—with a side of comedy.
episodes.episodeName: Swaad Aasan ! Ab yoga se hi Hoga

episodes.duration: Bollywood’s finest hit the kitchen tracks . only to derail into delightful disaster! Metro In Dino met Laughter Chefs, and together they served chaos on a platter.
Media meets masala as the paparazzi step into our kitchen! But this time, the tables turn—our celebrity chefs are grilling the media, not the food!
The kitchen turned into a full-on party zone!  the Laughter Chef family went all out to make her feel special. A complete rollercoaster of emotions, madness, and laughter
From divine chants to grand satvik bhojan cooked by the Laughter Chefs, the episode is filled with purity & divine blessings, with a generous dose of laughter on the sides.
Chef Harpal flips the game, risk your stars to win big or lose it all! Gurmeet & Debina join the kitchen madness, bringing double the panga from Pati Patni aur Panga jodiyon ka reality check!
The kitchen turns into a dance floor as DJ Chetas drops the beat and newlyweds Hina-Rocky face their first rasoi panga! A golden jubilee packed with love, laughter, drama and delicious chaos!
episodes.episodeName: It’s Party Time: Laughter Chefs Turns 50!

episodes.duration: The semi-finale gets a 'Dard Bhara' twist as the 90s icon Altaf Raja graces the kitchen! Aiming to get a step closer to the trophy, the contestants pour their hearts into the dishes.
Iconic leading Bahus grace the kitchen in the grand semi-finale! With glitz, glamour, and loads of drama, these divas bring star power and chaos to the cook-off!
episodes.episodeName: TV's Biggest Frame in the Semi-finale!

episodes.duration: The finale weekend kicks off, but Chef Harpal has one final twist! With surprises, entertainment and non-stop fun, the party sets the stage for an epic end to the season.
The Jodis battle it out in the final cook-off for the coveted title. With special guests from Pati, Pati aur Panga joining in, the finale overflows with unlimited entertainment!
episodes.episodeName: The Grand Cook-off! Who Takes the Trophy ?

episodes.duration: Cookie Baba and his magical mouse visit the kitchen to predict the celebrities' futures. Hilarious fortunes and surprising predictions turn the set into a fun extravaganza.
Jodis are split up for a chaotic 14-dish challenge as mascot Tikly doubles the stakes. Both partners must win their individual battles or the team walks away empty-handed.
The Laughter Chefs celebrated Bharti’s birthday with love, laughter, heartfelt surprises, and special dishes, turning her big day into a memorable celebration.
Mini versions of our celebrities take over the kitchen and became the biggest Khatra of the day. With adorable demands, and endless energy, these little champs create cute chaos.
The contestants receive a heartwarming surprise as their biggest fans visit the kitchen, filling it with love, laughter, gifts, and unforgettable moments.
1h 26m
With Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi away, Chef Bharti takes charge and unveils the biggest Khatra ever - lose the battle, and lose your station! Who will survive this ultimate Khatra?
The Dhamaal 4 gang hits the Laughter Chefs kitchen! Expect total madness, laughter, and non-stop entertainment. Don't miss their hilarious antics and crazy cooking!
Khatra takes over the kitchen, introducing shocking twists and unexpected surprises. As chaos unfolds, the Laughter Chefs are pushed to their limits.
When the entire Colors family reunites under one roof, expect nonstop laughter, surprises, and entertainment. You know the family, but not what happens next!
Tejasswi's surprise birthday party fills the Laughter Chefs kitchen with fun and celebrity guests. But a shocking announcement leaves everyone stunned and changes the mood.
The Laughter Chefs kitchen turns into a 90’s nostalgia fest with retro vibes and iconic memories. Special guest Rahul Roy adds charm, fun, and timeless entertainment.
Surprises, laughter, and Krushna’s favourite food take centre stage as the LC family celebrates his special day. Making the occasion even bigger, Randeep Hooda joins the party!
Nobody sees it coming as Sudesh Ji makes a stunning Dhurandhar comeback, leaving the entire kitchen amazed as he takes his revenge on Nia with a masterstroke.
The Laughter Chefs kitchen turns into a full-on akhada! Watch as powerful pehalwaans bring intense dangal, dhamaka, and non-stop laughter to the show.
1h 23m
The Laughter Chefs family throws a grand surprise reception for Karan and Teja, turning the celebration into a laughter-filled party packed with heartfelt wishes and nonstop masti.
Varun Dhawan, Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde spice up the kitchen with nonstop fun and madness. Chaos ensues when Krushna and Bharti turn into Varun’s naughty kids.
episodes.episodeName: Hai Laughter Chefs Toh Masti Honi Hai!

episodes.duration: Wedding vibes and kitchen chaos take over as the Chefs celebrate Karan and Teja's "big day". The madness escalates when Sara Ali Khan and Rakul Preet Singh join in on the fun.
The Laughter Chefs celebrate Mother's Day with their moms, featuring fun cooking challenges and a lively talent showdown filled with love, laughter, and memorable moments.
Double the madness, double the laughs! From cracking jokes to crafting hilarious dishes, the Laughter Chefs serve up the perfect recipe for World Laughter Day!
Sunita Mami surprises Krushna and Kashmera in the kitchen, ending a 14-year wait. The emotional reunion turns into a "Mami Day" celebration filled with love and special dishes.
Chaos erupts as the Laughter Highness Queen arrives to honour Abhishek as Lord Abhishek. What follows is a wild desi tour led by the contestants, packed with madness and surprises!
The Laughter Chefs family turns Samarth’s birthday into a hilarious “Ignore Day,” filled with fun. The celebration features surprises and special dishes dedicated to him!
On Chef Harpal's birthday, everyone comes together with their own fun criteria. However, he and Bharti respond with an even greater challenge, turning things into pure craziness!
Breaking news from the Laughter Chefs set! Chaos reigns in the kitchen, and Shrivardhan Trivedi and Dibang are reporting live. Stay tuned for a laughter-filled disaster!
It’s double the celebration and double the fun in the kitchen. For Baisakhi and Shubho Noboborsho, Mamta Lehri and Debinna add flavours, masti, and festive cheer to the madness.
The kitchen gets possessed as Bhoot Bangla stars, Rajpal Yadav, Ganesh Acharya, Wamiqa Gabbi, and Mithila Palkar, create spooky chaos and serve chills, thrills, and unlimited fun.
The Laughter Chefs kitchen turns gangster as Dacoit stars Anurag Kashyap, Mrunal Thakur, and Adivi Sesh join. Loot, hungama, and explosive dishes await!
Joint family chaos meets kitchen combat on Laughter Chefs. Two sides, one stove, endless masti. Who will outcook, outlaugh, and claim the golden star?
The Laughter Chefs family comes together to celebrate Ankita Lokhande's birthday. But with April Fools around the corner, the surprise quickly turns into a hilarious prank fest.
Lights, camera, kitchen! Bharti, Sudesh, and Krushna take charge, turning the set of Laughter Chefs into a drama stage exposing the hilarious chaos unfolding behind the scenes.
The Laughter Chefs family celebrates Eid with warmth and joy. A heartfelt Eidi for Jannat and Ali and festive treats make it a special, laughter-filled episode.
The Laughter Chefs kitchen turns into a Bollywood set as Mamta Kulkarni makes her first-ever appearance, bringing glamour and nostalgia with jodis cooking up filmy moments!
The kitchen turns into a lively desi mela, bringing back the joy and nostalgia of childhood fairs as the jodis cook iconic treats, enjoy traditional games, and battle to win stars.
Cricket fever hits the Laughter Chefs kitchen as chefs are auctioned into rival teams, battling it out with their culinary skills to win the ultimate Chefs Premier League trophy.
Laughter Chefs celebrates Women's Day, surprising ladies with gifts and special moments. The kitchen overflows with sweet gestures and laughter, honouring amazing women.
Stethoscopes meet spatulas as India’s top doctors join Laughter Chefs' kitchen. They share wellness secrets, while the chefs add humour, creating a recipe of health and laughter.
Kitchen chaos meets Holi colours as the chefs trade spatulas for splashes. It’s a festive fusion of laughter and vibrant dishes, turning the stove into a full-on holiday party!
episodes.episodeName: Holi Ke Rang, Laughter Chefs Ke Sang

episodes.duration: Chefs unleash their inner animals as the kitchen turns into a jungle. From hunting ingredients to battling at the stove, only the fiercest will survive this wild cooking challenge!
The Laughter Chef family celebrates Aly’s birthday with heartfelt surprises, his favourite dishes, and lots of laughter, making it a warm and memorable moment in the kitchen.
The fun kitchen turns into a high-pressure masterclass as Chef Sanjeev Kapoor puts every Jodi to the test. Comedy takes a backseat while perfection and discipline rule the game.
Today, the order givers turn into order takers! The house helps of Laughter Chefs step into the kitchen, flipping the roles and serving a fun-filled chaos and comedy.
episodes.episodeName: Laughter Chefs’ House Chefs in the House

episodes.duration: Love is in the air and in the kitchen too, but so is the heat among all the cooks! Aly receives a big surprise that leaves everyone stunned.
Love is on the menu as Propose Day kicks off! The kitchen heats up with romantic gestures and hilarious chaos, making this the perfect start to a heartfelt Love Week.
1h 28m
episodes.episodeName: No Rules, No Limits, Only Manmarzi!

episodes.duration: Teja and Arjun storm back into the kitchen, raising the bar with stellar dishes and serious competition. Will the #TarJan winning streak continue, or will a jodi break their shine?
The OG chef gang returns, bringing back classic chaos, crazy laughter, and the madness that started it all.
Team Kaanta and Team Chhuri clash in the ultimate Laughter Chefs’ finale as stars are gambled, and pressure peaks, ending with one team lifting the trophy and sealing their place i
episodes.episodeName: Team Kaanta Aur Chhuri Ka Akhari Vaar

episodes.duration: Bharti returns with a bang, instantly turning the kitchen into a laugh-packed house. With fun and flavour, the teams charge into their long-awaited final face-off.
episodes.episodeName: Bharti Ki Waapsi Final Face-off Mein

episodes.duration: Glamour meets giggles as Splitsvilla stars step into the Laughter Chefs kitchen with style, spice, and sizzling competition, and with friendship, fun, and unstoppable laughter.
Karan is back and he’s not holding back! With Team Chhuri falling behind, the pressure is high, the stakes are higher, and only one team will rise in this fiery comeback.
The Laughter Chefs family celebrates Lohri with energy, vibrant festivities, and heartfelt cheer. Amid the fun, which team will earn the most stars and shine?
Arjun makes a long-awaited return to the Laughter Chefs family. His comeback promises surprising twists, laughter, and fun, leaving the teams on edge.
episodes.episodeName: Arjun Is Back in the Family

episodes.duration: India’s street food takes the spotlight as Purani Khau Galli clashes with Nayi Khau Galli. Classic flavours get modern twists in a showdown between Team Kaanta and Team Chhuri!
episodes.episodeName: Purani Khau Galli vs Nayi Khau Galli

episodes.duration: Get ready for an inter-college fest as College Kaanta takes on College Chhuri. The kitchen becomes a canteen of chaos and nostalgia, with everyone reliving their college life.
episodes.episodeName: Student of the Year LC Edition

episodes.duration: Superfan Sunidhi Chauhan enters the Laughter Chefs kitchen! From iconic vocals to musical chaos, the kitchen turns into a full-blown concert.
A fun-filled baby shower brings smiles, surprises and heartfelt emotions for Bharti. New Year celebrations get even brighter with Rahul Vaidya’s unexpected return.
episodes.episodeName: A Special Baby Shower for Bharti

episodes.duration: It’s Christmas time at Laughter Chefs as Team Kaanta and Team Chhuri plan the ultimate party with a surprise twist. Will all be merry, or will it end in complete kitchen chaos?
episodes.episodeName: Ho Ho Ho…Santa in the Kitchen!

episodes.duration: Laughter Chefs turn full on Laughter-wood! Celebration gets grander as Madhuri Dixit joins as Mrs. Deshpande, challenging all chefs to cook her favourite dish. Who’ll impress her?
episodes.episodeName: Dhak Dhak! Madhuri Graces the Show

episodes.duration: King of comedy, Kapil Sharma, returns to Colors after 11 years. With jokes, cooking chaos and masti, he turns the Laughter Chefs’ kitchen into a full-fledged comedy stadium.
Powerstar Pawan Singh brings in the full Bhojpuri swag. As both teams cook iconic Bihari dishes, the kitchen turns into a high-energy battleground of flavours, fun, and fierce comp
episodes.episodeName: Powerstar Aa Gail on Laughter Chefs

episodes.duration: Parents storm the kitchen with complaints, turning the cook-off into chaos. With Moms and Dads cooking too, will this surprise entry fix the madness or double the trouble?
episodes.episodeName: Parents Teacher Meeting: Class Lag Gayi!

episodes.duration: Habibi it’s international! Under Dubai’s glam and bling, two teams battle over tricky Middle-Eastern dishes. With Chhuri ahead, Kaanta must spice up fast or get left behind.
Unpredictable twists send Abhishek and Samarth up in the air. A sweet surprise for Kashmera lifts everyone amid the Kaanta Chhuri takkar.
episodes.episodeName: Chef Mode: Up in the Air

episodes.duration: The kitchen heats up as teams clash in chaotic cook-offs. Can Elvish maintain his winning streak and keep his team ahead?
episodes.episodeName: Team Chhuri Ko Mili Kaante Ki Takkar

episodes.duration: 1h 16m
Laughter Chefs kicks off a new season loaded with surprises, entertainment and chaos, bringing in new faces, new bonds and an exciting new journey.
